history.name: DataExtraction_Expert
history.content:
Goal: Count Rick Riordan titles not on shelves (statuses: Checked Out, Overdue). We'll directly search the PDF text for occurrences of "Rick Riordan" and extract nearby status lines rather than building a full table first. Plan:
- Extract full text from the PDF.
- For each occurrence of "Rick Riordan", capture the title above it and status below it.
- Build a quick list of (title, status) pairs and count non-Available.
Request to Computer_terminal: Run the following code to extract matches and print titles with their statuses.

Code:
from functions import extract_pdf_text

pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)

lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
riordan_entries = []
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.lower() == 'rick riordan':
        # The structure appears as Title (line i-1), Author (i), Publisher (i+1), Genre (i+2), Status (i+3)
        if i - 1 >= 0 and i + 3 < len(lines):
            title = lines[i-1]
            status = lines[i+3]
            riordan_entries.append((title, status))

print("Rick Riordan entries found:")
for t, s in riordan_entries:
    print(f"- {t} :: {s}")
